info.name: Alfouad Pharmacies - Sale Order API
info.description: API endpoints for creating sale orders and retrieving location data.

request.description: Returns available stock quantities for all products across all internal locations that have a location code set. Only returns lines where available quantity is greater than 0.
Returns all available location codes and their corresponding warehouse names.
Creates a sale order. If customer mobile exists, updates the contact. Otherwise creates a new one. Warehouse is resolved automatically from location_code.
